description: This Java class 'JournalEntryRunningBalanceUpdateServiceImpl' implements functionality for updating the running balances in journal entries within the accounting system. It contains methods to update organization-wide or office-specific running balances by querying and batch updating journal entry data in the database, with helper methods for balance calculation and data mapping.

classes.name: JournalEntryRunningBalanceUpdateServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the service responsible for recalculating and updating running balances for journal entries at organization and office levels, involving database queries and batch updates.

classes.name: GLJournalEntryMapper
classes.description: A RowMapper class to map SQL query result rows to JournalEntryData objects.

methods.name: updateRunningBalance
methods.description: Calculates and updates the organization-wide journal entry running balances starting from the earliest uncalculated entry date.

methods.name: updateOfficeRunningBalance
methods.description: Handles updating the running balances for a specific office, or the entire organization if no office ID is provided, after validating input.

methods.name: updateOrganizationRunningBalance
methods.description: Internal method to compute and batch update running balances across all journal entries for the organization up to a specified date.

methods.name: updateRunningBalance
methods.description: Internal method to compute and batch update running balances for journal entries in a specific office.

methods.name: calculateRunningBalance
methods.description: Calculates the new running balance for a journal entry based on its type and account type, updating the balance map.

methods.name: organizationRunningBalanceSchema
methods.description: Returns SQL query string to retrieve journal entries for organization-wide running balance calculations.

methods.name: officeRunningBalanceSchema
methods.description: Returns SQL query string to retrieve journal entries for a specific office's running balance calculations.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a SQL ResultSet row to a JournalEntryData object with relevant fields.
